scripts.text:
[Dwarf]
Hey did you see an ugly Goblin come by? He stole something from me!
scripts.translation:
[矮人]
嘿，你有没有看到一个丑陋的哥布林经过？他偷了我的东西！

scripts.text:
[Dwarf]
Help me!
Please, help me!
scripts.translation:
[矮人]
帮帮我！
求求你，帮帮我！

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么？

scripts.text: Nevermind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Dwarf]
I am Morestone and I collect rare gems.
scripts.translation:
[矮人]
我叫莫尔斯通，专门收集稀有宝石。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
In my travels, I was told that there were a lot of gems in Valfreyja and Nidhoggur, so I came down here.
But here, the soil is very hard to dig into. Fortunately, my ^3131FFPickaxe^000000 never lets me down!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
旅行时听说发菲依雅和尼德霍格有很多宝石，我就来了。
可这里的土很硬，难挖得很。
幸好，我的^3131FF镐^000000从没让我失望！

scripts.text: Pickaxe!
scripts.translation: 镐！

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Yes, my beloved pickaxe!
I always carry it with me, you know?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
没错，我心爱的镐！
我总是把它带在身边。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
We started working here together.
After a few days, we finally found something!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
我和它一起在这里挖掘，几天后终于有了发现！

scripts.text: Something strange??
scripts.translation: 奇怪的东西？

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
No, but it was worth quite a lot.
But we did not have much time to celebrate. Suddenly, a monster appeared that stole my pickaxe.
His name was^3131FFKublin^000000!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
不是，不过很值钱。
还没来得及庆祝，就突然冒出一只魔物，把我的镐偷走了。
它叫^3131FF榔锤酷布灵^000000！

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
He stole my Pickaxe!
I can't live without it...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
它偷走了我的镐！
没有它我活不下去...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is this the pickaxe that you've been looking for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这就是你一直在找的镐吗？

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
You found my Pickaxe?
Show me, please!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
你找到了我的镐？
请给我看看！

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Oh, my! You've returned it to me!
My precious pickaxe, I thought I lost you forever.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
天哪！你帮我找回来了！
我的宝贝镐，我还以为永远见不到你了。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
You are great! What guild are you from?
Could it be Gravity or Mercury?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
你真了不起！来自哪个公会？
难道是Gravity或Mercury？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am a member of the ^3131FF{1}^.

[Morestone]
Oh... That guild will receive my greatest respect.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
哦...我对这个公会致以最高的敬意。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Oh! My friend, I am very grateful for your help.
As a reward, I will tell you about a mysterious area I have discovered recently.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
朋友，太感谢你了。
作为答谢，我告诉你一个最近发现的神秘地方。

scripts.text: A mysterious area?
scripts.translation: 神秘区域？

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
That's right. I found it when I was digging around here.
It looks like it was made for some special purpose, but since there are no gems around there, I have no interest in it.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
没错，在附近挖掘时发现的。
看起来像是为某种特殊目的建造的，不过那里没有宝石，我就没兴趣了。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Instead of going there alone, I think it would be more fun to go with your friends...
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
与其独自前往，我觉得和朋友们一起去会更有趣...

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
If you want, I can take ^3131FFyou and your guild members^000000 to explore that area.
Do you want to go there now?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
如果你愿意，我可以带^3131FF你和你的公会成员^000000去探索那个区域。
你想现在去吗？

scripts.text: Wait! I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 等等，还没准备好

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Take your time, and find a place to gather your friends.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
别急，找个地方召集你的朋友们吧。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
Alright! Let's go.
If your friends visit me again later, I will guide them to that area again.
Don't forget, dwarves are grateful beings! Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
好！出发吧。
你的朋友之后来找我，我也会带他们去那个地方。
别忘了，矮人可是懂得感恩的！Hahaha!

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
I will tell you how to find him.
Kublin wears a ridiculous golden hat, It should be easy to recognise him by that.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
我来告诉你怎么找到他。
榔锤酷布灵戴着一顶滑稽的金色帽子，凭这个特征应该很容易认出他。

scripts.text:
[Dwarf]
Ahhh...

[Morestone]
I, Morestone, have made an alliance with the {0} guild.
Oh, you are a member.
Would you like to go to the mysterious area?
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
我莫尔斯通，已经和{0}公会结盟。
哦，你也是这个公会的成员。
要去那个神秘地方吗？

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 出发吧

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
I hope you enjoy yourself, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
希望你在旅途中玩得开心，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Morestone]
If you need my assistance, just ask.
Ah! Dont forget, I hate monsters! So I don't want to see them. It will be better if you ask for another favour.
scripts.translation:
[莫尔斯通]
需要帮忙，尽管开口。
啊！可别忘了，我讨厌魔物，见都不想见！
所以最好找我帮别的忙。

scripts.text: A lonely clown is juggling.
scripts.translation: 一个孤独的小丑正在表演杂耍。

scripts.text: When looked at closely, the clown is just a puppet that looks like a human.
scripts.translation: 仔细一看，小丑只是个外形像人的木偶。

scripts.text: The clown stops, then starts moving in accordance to your movements, noises start to emit from it's mouth.
scripts.translation: 小丑停了下来，随后开始跟着你的动作移动，嘴里发出了声音。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Beep beep beep.
Hello, my friends!
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
Beep beep beep.
你好，朋友们！

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
I am the loyal servant of Gergath, and I have finally received my orders.
I am happy to hear all the laughter, but without my master's permission, I can't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
我是格加斯的忠实仆人，终于接到了命令。
听到大家的笑声我很高兴，但没有主人的允许，我什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Did you get permission from Gergath?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
你得到格加斯的允许了吗？

scripts.text: I need to check that.
scripts.translation: 我得确认一下

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Please give me the palm of your hand.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
请把手掌伸出来。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Okay, I see...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
好，我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Indeed...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
确实如此...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Verification completed!
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
验证完成！

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
Hm? that's right.
When is that person coming? I am very bored~!
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]
嗯？对了。
那个人什么时候来？我好无聊~！

scripts.text:
[Pierrot Pier]
^3131FF<You're someone who can only think about nonsense everyday, you have no focus at all.>^000000
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗·皮尔]

Alright, let's begin!

[皮埃罗·皮尔]

My master Gergath sincerely wishes you joy for you and your family everyday.

[皮埃罗·皮尔]

[Pierrot Pier]
Alright, would you like to play the game Gergath has prepared for you?

[皮埃罗·皮尔]

scripts.text: Game instructions.
scripts.translation: 查看游戏规则

scripts.text: Skip instructions.
scripts.translation: 跳过规则

scripts.text: Refuse game.
scripts.translation: 不玩游戏

The game prepared by my master is very unique, yet simple and fun!
